meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索网页并提取链接内容,快速获取技术资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在研究或开发中快速获取网页和论文内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and extract page content to get technical info
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly gather web pages and papers for work or study.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能做网络搜索,也能抓取指定 URL 的网页、文章、学术 PDF 内容;搜索时会偏向学术与科技来源,可限定研究论文类别或指定学术网站,还支持一次批量提取多个链接。
howto.when: 当用户要求搜索、查资料、抓取页面或提取文章内容时触发,尤其适用于科学性与技术性话题的检索。

say.text: 帮我搜一下 2025 年关于大语言模型的综述文章。
say.note: 会按研究论文类别搜索,偏向学术来源。

say.text: 把 arxiv 上这篇论文的全文内容抓下来。
say.note: 会提取该 URL 的页面内容。

say.text: 只在 arxiv 和 nature 上查“相变材料”的最新进展。
say.note: 会用学术域名过滤搜索结果。

howto.what_en: Claude can search the web and fetch content from given URLs (pages, articles, academic PDFs). It favors scholarly/technical sources, supports research-paper category and domain filtering, and batch extraction.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to search, look something up, fetch a page, or extract an article; also for scientific/technical queries wanting scholarly filtering.

say_en.text: Search for 2025 survey articles on large language models.
say_en.note: Runs a web search with category=research paper.

say_en.text: Fetch the full content of this arXiv paper.
say_en.note: Extracts the page content from the URL.

say_en.text: Look up recent progress on 'phase-change materials' only on arXiv and Nature.
say_en.note: Filters results to scholarly domains via --include-domains.
